1.shows: The code on the drop-off family's sale written online in the long-outage window: one discount row, cash, the platform's use count 0 → 1; the same number again on the same till: refused in the words "Code "ZZTEST897A02" can only be used once per customer." — not the till's own once-per-customer words

2.shows: In the window the payment step showed Hold sale open with no counter-box line; the sale was held (in Held sales on the till and on the platform), resumed once the lane was back, and paid in cash once

st.gaveUp: Couldn't register these children The connection dropped and has not come back yet. What was saved stays saved online. Check the counter's internet, then press Continue again — the till finishes this same registration online, without entering anyone twice. Nobody has been checked in or charged — the details are still on screen.

held.toast: Sale held ZZ TEST SCRUM-897 held g2-02 — in Held sales on every till at this branch. Nothing was issued.

lines: This till is working through its counter box while the platform cannot be reached — resuming a held sale needs the platform. Try again when the connection is back.

3.shows: In 2 window(s) the Held sales list, which could not be read, was read again -0.1 s and -0.1 s after the platform answered the registration, and "could not be read" went away

5.shows: An ordinary online sale with ZZTEST897A02 (use 2 of its limit of 2) was accepted on the same till, paid in cash online once, and the platform's count rose by exactly one (1 → 2)

4a.shows: A till offline from the start sold 1 kid + 1 adult with a code through its box: Hold sale shut with the counter-box line, cash on the box; the till's own copy then refused the used-up code to the next customer; after the restore the box handed the finalised sale to the platform, which counted one use

hold.reason: This sale was rung up on the counter box while the platform could not be reached — it cannot be held. Take the payment now.
